question:
(i) If \(A+B+C=n\pi\) where \(n\) is a positive integer, show that
\[
\sin 2A+\sin 2B+\sin 2C=(-1)^{n-1}4\sin A\sin B\sin C.
\]

(ii) Let triangles \(ABC\) and \(DEF\) be inscribed in the same circle. If the triangles are of equal perimeter, then prove that
\[
\sin A+\sin B+\sin C=\sin D+\sin E+\sin F.
\]

(iii) State and prove the converse of (ii) above.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
